title: Product-pinned Ribasim v2026.1.1 allocation-clock contract

sequencing.rationale: Establish the clock semantics of the exact Ribasim release consumed by the pinned iMOD Coupler product before any dynamic product test.

version_relation.release_to_research: research pin is 103 commits ahead of v2026.1.1
version_relation.meaning: DUMMY-19 clock results against the later research pin are not automatically product-binary authority.

hypotheses: BMI.update_until in v2026.1.1 delegates to step!(model, dt).
With fixed allocation.dt, step! solves allocation only when the current physical time lies on the allocation.dt grid before advancing the requested BMI interval.
The fixed-allocation.dt path does not use solver.saveat to schedule allocation solves.
update_allocation!(model) defaults record=true, so an allocation.dt-aligned solve applies UserDemand allocation through parse_allocations!.
The saveat-capped allocation-tstop behavior qualified against f965 is therefore not the clock contract of v2026.1.1.
For a RibaMod product run with 6-hour MODFLOW steps and allocation.dt=24h, the 6-hour BMI endpoints do not create additional UserDemand allocation decisions within the day.
For the same product steps with allocation.dt=6h, every 6-hour step start is an allocation boundary and the new UserDemand allocation is applied before that physical segment.
Changing solver.saveat alone must not change fixed-allocation.dt management cadence in this release.
forbidden: no transfer of f965 saveat sensitivity claims to v2026.1.1 without direct evidence
no product-runtime claim from source audit alone

authority_rebind.meaning: Exact Ribasim v2026.1.1 release-clock source contract rebound after qualified DUMMY-20A; hypotheses unchanged.
